name: relay
description: Relay is a downloadable chat app with servers, channels, and direct messages.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,web,app -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix server run check && npm --prefix client run check
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:linux
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
